# MediaFlow Studio 1.2.0 — AI Video Enhancement

## ✨ What's new

### 🪄 AI upscaling & frame interpolation, on your own GPU
In the Converter, open **Advanced** → **AI Video Enhancement** and pick a target:

| | Setting | What happens |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| 🔍 | **Target resolution** (720p → 4K) | Higher than the source → **AI upscaling** with Real-ESRGAN. Lower → classic high-quality downscale. |
| 🎞️ | **Target frame rate** (24 → 60 fps) | Higher than the source → **AI frame interpolation** with RIFE: smooth new in-between frames. Lower → frames dropped evenly. |
| ⚖️ | **AI model** | *Fast* for everyday clips, *Best quality* for the cleanest detail on real footage. |

- Runs **100% locally** on NVIDIA, AMD or Intel graphics (Vulkan) — nothing is uploaded anywhere.
- Final encode on your GPU (NVENC / Quick Sync / AMF) as usual.
- Works with every preset (Clean export, Proxy, TikTok…) and with plain MP4 / MOV / MKV.
- Long jobs say what they're doing: *AI upscaling · 2:10 left*, *AI interpolation*… and can be cancelled anytime.
- Processed in small chunks, so even 4K never fills your disk. HDR and variable-frame-rate clips are prepared automatically.

### 🎛️ Also
- Advanced settings now only apply while **Advanced** mode is open — Simple mode is always just the preset.

Already on 1.1.x? The app offers this update automatically — click **Update**, then **Restart & Install**.
